name: Wheel Turn
description: Turn on one foot as if on a wheel and come round to the foe's flank with the step.

name: Cycle Strike
description: Strike with the heel of the hand in an arc and bring the hand back to guard along the same arc.

name: Rebound Ward
description: Meet a blow with a ring of returning qi that sends a small part of its force back at the attacker.

name: Renewal Breath
description: Draw one slow breath that returns a little strength to the tired limbs of the user or an ally.

name: Past Flicker
description: Let a flash of old recognition warn of a foe's habits in the stance before the first blow.

name: Loop Bind
description: Loop a ring of cycling qi round a foe's wrist so every pull returns to the same place.

name: Breath Return
description: Draw back the qi lost to a hard blow and ease the winded chest of an ally.

name: Ebb Flow
description: Let the user's qi ebb and flow in a steady breath so each strike lands as if newly rested.

name: Renewing Guard
description: Hold a shell of cycling qi round the torso that renews itself as blows chip at it.

name: Return Touch
description: Touch the foe and send back the force of a blow the user took a moment ago.

name: Round Dart
description: Throw a ring of qi that curves out to strike and then flies back toward the hand.

name: Prior Echo
description: Recall the foe's next stance as a quick flash, as though it had been met in an earlier life.

name: Self Thread
description: Hold the thread of one's own self steady so the body keeps its form under strain.

name: Rebirth Seed
description: Plant a seed of renewal in an ally's wound that closes the skin over the next few breaths.

name: Husk Step
description: Step out of a shell of old qi left standing so the foe's blow lands on the husk.

name: Wake Strike
description: Send a narrow thrust of renewing qi that jolts and wrenches the foe's nerves.

name: Lifeline Hold
description: Hold a line of qi round the heart that keeps it beating after a heavy hit.

name: Dizzy Spin
description: Spin the foe's sense of direction round a ring of qi so that left and right swap.

name: Skin Shed
description: Shed a layer of dried qi skin on contact so a blow lands on the husk and slides away.

name: Molt Mend
description: Molt the bruised outer skin of an ally and let fresh skin come in under it.

name: Renew Fist
description: Punch with a fist that takes back a little of the user's tired qi on contact.

name: Fresh Pulse
description: Set a fresh pulse in the ally's wrist to quicken the blood and sharpen movement.

name: Cast Off
description: Throw off a foe's grip with a sudden shed of qi that jolts the hold.

name: Seed Dart
description: Throw a hard seed of qi that bursts into a faint green shock on the target.
